# ---------- camera builder ----------
def make_cam(name, pos, look_dir, up, fov_deg=39.6):
    cd = bpy.data.cameras.new(name)
    cd.sensor_width = 36.0
    import math as _m
    cd.lens = 18.0/_m.tan(_m.radians(fov_deg/2.0))
    ob = bpy.data.objects.new(name, cd)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(ob)
    L = Vector(look_dir); U = Vector(up)
    R = L.cross(U); R.normalize()
    U2 = R.cross(L); U2.normalize()
    M = Matrix((R, U2, -L)).transposed().to_4x4()
    M.translation = Vector(pos)
    ob.matrix_world = M
    return ob
